title: Soft Mattress
text: Soft Mattress. This mattress is suppose to be Medium-Firm. It is really soft. I would hate to sleep on the soft one. You can not sit on the end of the bed you slide off. There is just no support on the sides. For a guess who is going to spend a couples of night it would be great. My 19 year old daughter tells me it is nicer than a box spring but not nearly as nice as my Temperpedic.

product_metadata.title: Airdown Twin Mattress, 8 Inch Memory Foam Mattress for Kids, Medium Firm Green Tea Gel Mattress, Twin Size Mattress in a Box, Low Profile for Bunk Bed, Made in USA, CertiPUR-US Certified
features: 【Improves Sleep Quality】 Our mattress features in adaptable AeroFusion Green Tea gel-infused memory foam, help absorb heat and carry it away from the body, improving memory foam’s comfort level and ability to regulate temperature. Maximize the experience of deep and refreshing sleep at night with a breathable and cooling mattress without being stuck in a hot night. Waking up with energy every morning has never been easier.

【Built For Comfort】 This bed mattress is designed for back sleepers, side sleepers and stomach sleepers. The medium-firm feel helps them relieve back stiffness, pain and discomfort, while relaxing their muscles. Our 8-inch bed mattress features a layered memory foam design that provides complete support for your body and pressure relieving. We aim to keep a balance between firmness and softness to meet everyone's different sleep needs.

【Skin-friendly Mattress】 You can sleep on this 8-inch mattress queen with confidence because all our beddings are CertiPUR-US certified to ensure performance and safety. The Fiberglass-Free FR inner cover and Graphene Fabric cover provide you with a healthy and naturally skin-friendly sleep surface, making it a top choice for upscale home mattresses. The elegant queen gel memory foam mattress is a great gift for children, parents, or friends.

【Stable & Durable】 The bottom layer of our mattresses is a supportive Flex Support Foam Base, ensure long-lasting durability and stability. High resilience foam can effectively reduce noise and prevent shaking, allow you to sleep comfortably for whole night. The dimension of twin mattress is 75'' x 38'' x 8'', compatible with most bases and frames, such as foundations, platform bed, slat bases, Bunk Bed, box springs, trundle bed and floors.

【Easy To Install & Use】 Our memory foam mattresses are manufactured in the US and packaged as a ready-to-ship mattress-in-a-Box, which are easy to set up. Simply unbox and unroll the mattress, expanding to its original shape within 48-72 hours. The removable and machine washable mattress cover is durable and easy to clean. With 30 years limited warranty makes the mattresses a great investment.
